kit: Vision Pro Stroke Patient Education Kit
physics_contract: Static presentation geometry by default; optional app transforms may be kinematic only. No fluid, pressure, puncture, insertion, deployment, tissue, vessel, device-vessel, or radiation physics are encoded.
source_provenance: All geometry and materials are project-authored procedurally in Blender; no third-party models, textures, or product designs are used.
conditionality_rules: Femoral, radial, or another access route is a clinician-selected option; the catalog does not prescribe one.
Aspiration, stent-retriever, combined, or another reperfusion strategy is clinician-selected; no tool category is universally required.
Contrast, flush, anesthesia/sedation, imaging controls, access-site hemostasis, and closure options depend on patient factors, local protocol, and clinician judgment.
Puncture-site compression, band, closure-applicator, and dressing representations are alternatives or adjuncts, not a simultaneous required combination.

warnings: Generic, non-branded educational representations; not cleared or marketed devices and not a complete procedure inventory.
Geometry, dimensions, control layouts, materials, colors, connections, and relative placement are visually plausible concepts only, not specifications.
Do not use for device selection, compatibility decisions, sizing, navigation, procedural training, sterile-field setup, medication/contrast preparation, treatment planning, or outcome prediction.
Do not infer an access route, anesthesia plan, procedural sequence, closure method, contrast protocol, radiation-control mapping, or institutional workflow from these models.
Keep this module in an endovascular-only branch; do not activate it as part of craniotomy, open cranial surgery, or post-craniotomy head-dressing scenes.
Interventional neuroradiology, nursing, radiography, anesthesia, infection-control, human-factors, and regulatory review are required before any patient-facing deployment.
